### The Old Covenant Priesthood
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/old-covenant-priesthood
Passage: Leviticus 8:12-13
Points:
- A mediator is fundamentally required for fallen human beings to be reconciled to God.
- The old covenant high priest served as a type foreshadowing the ultimate mediation of Jesus Christ.
- Aaron and his sons were visibly set apart for service through anointing oil and priestly vestments.
- While the earthly priesthood protected Israel from divine judgment, ordinary worshippers remained separated from God's presence.
- Examining the ordination of the Levitical priests helps believers appreciate Christ's superior, once-for-all mediatorial work.
